name: Cost-scope methodology: equipment price versus package versus installed plant
description: Sources explicitly warn that $/kW figures are not comparable until scope, output basis and dollar year are stated. HTR and SecondWatt provide sourced scope ladders; EIA provides a line-item breakdown. Escalation factors named by HTR are recorded, not applied.

capex.metric: equipment price, gas turbines of GE 7HA.03 simple-cycle plant
capex.basis: Brattle and Sargent & Lundy 2025 PJM CONE report, quoted by SecondWatt; owner-furnished equipment with freight to site

capex.metric: installed cost, Rest of RTO frame turbine plant
capex.basis: 2025 PJM CONE study; overnight cost $1,361/kW; installed adds 23.0% of capital carrying costs

capex.metric: combustion turbine cost increase since 2022 PJM CONE study
capex.basis: SecondWatt quoting PJM study: rose from $225/kW to $409/kW, an 81% real increase; 37% real increase since August 2024 ($298/kW)
HTR: recipient equipment at about $820/kW (grade D analyst) against owner package figure of $1,000/kW

capex.metric: scope adder, package to package plus balance of plant
capex.basis: HTR: two owners reporting both levels on the same call; +25% to +55%

capex.metric: scope adder, package plus BOP to installed plant
capex.basis: HTR: owner $1,550/kW against a 2026 utility plan at $2,460/kW, about +59%

capex.metric: major owner-furnished equipment share, EIA H-class simple-cycle case
capex.basis: EIA January 2024 report Table 4-1 as decomposed by SecondWatt: $132.8m of $350.088m; range across four EIA 2024 gas cases

capex.metric: named escalation index used by HTR for generation cost normalisation
capex.basis: BLS producer price index for turbines and turbine generator sets, annual average; transformers use power and distribution transformer index; generators use motors and generators index. No currency conversion or generic escalation applied in this library entry.

sources.note: Sources explicitly warn that $/kW figures are not comparable until scope, output

gaps.why: HTR states no public $/kVA exists; orders give value or rating but not both
gaps.next_action: Seek utility commission dockets with unredacted generator bids
